versions.changelog:
- Initial release of liquidation-magnet skill.
- Identifies real-time price levels with dense liquidation clusters across multiple exchanges (Kraken, Coinbase Advanced Trade, Hyperliquid).
- Secure, pay-per-use API—no account or subscription required; just an EVM wallet with USDC on Base mainnet.
- Early adopter and volume-based discounts automatically applied.
- Includes example code and sample API response.
